entities.summary: Galeazzo Mondella, known as Moderno, was an Italian goldsmith and medallist who became one of the most important designers of bronze plaquettes during the Italian Renaissance. His works were highly regarded by the Medicis and other powerful patrons, who sought his expertise in creating intricate designs for their courts. Mondella's contributions to the field of metalwork were significant, as he developed new techniques for casting and shaping bronze that allowed for greater precision and detail. His designs often featured mythological and allegorical themes, which added to the cultural and intellectual richness of the Renaissance. Mondella's legacy can be seen in the many works of art that he created during his lifetime, which continue to inspire artists and historians today.
